events.text: The last streetcar operations at the Car Barn ended with the closure of the Rosslyn–Benning Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The last streetcar operations at the Car Barn ended with the closure of the Rosslyn–Benning Line on April 30 , 1949 .

events.text: The building continued to store streetcars until May 1950.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The building continued to store streetcars until May 1950 .

events.text: The first floor was converted into office space toward the end of 1952.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Toward the end of 1952 , the first floor was converted into office space .
